heroSummary: Puyallup School District starts grades 1–12 on Wednesday, September 3, 2025, and kindergarten on Monday, September 8. Fair Day is September 10, the scheduled last day is June 16, 2026, and February 13 is now an attendance day replacing the December 17 closure.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 begin September 3, while kindergarten begins September 8, so the district does not have one first day for every student. Most instructional Mondays start one hour late, which changes regular transportation and care arrangements throughout the year. Fair Day on September 10 uses a 3.25-hour early dismissal and no lunch, making it different from ordinary Monday or conference schedules. Conference, grading, and school-improvement dates use a 2.5-hour early dismissal, so families need the matching campus bell time. The revised calendar records December 17 as an emergency closure and February 13 as the attendance day used to replace it. May 22 and dates after June 16 remain conditional make-up options, so the scheduled last day can still move. Lunch is not served on Fair Day or the last day, while the PDF says lunch is served on other attendance days.

customSections.label: How the 2025–26 Emergency Make-Up Sequence Works
customSections.content: February 13 is no longer conditional: the revised PDF marks it as the attendance day replacing the December 17 closure. May 22 remains the next in-year reserve. If more days are needed, PSD can use June 17–18 and additional days beginning June 22; June 19 remains the Juneteenth holiday between those windows.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Puyallup School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten starts Monday, September 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Puyallup Fair Day in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fair Day is Wednesday, September 10, 2025. All grades dismiss 3.25 hours early, and lunch is not served.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is there school in Puyallup on February 13, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The revised PSD calendar makes February 13 an attendance day to replace the emergency closure on December 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Puyallup Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students return Monday, January 5 on the one-hour late-start schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Puyallup Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 6–10, 2026. Students return Monday, April 13 on the one-hour late-start schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Puyallup School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 16, 2026, with a 3.25-hour early dismissal and no lunch. Emergency make-up needs could extend attendance beyond that date.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, against PSD's official calendar and bell-schedule pages and every date, color, legend note, attendance total, and footer rule in the revised one-page 2025–26 PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was rendered and checked visually because its color key separates no-school days, one-hour late starts, 2.5-hour early dismissals, 3.25-hour early dismissals, supplemental days, and emergency make-up dates.
The printed monthly student-day counts sum to 180; the staff supplemental days before opening are not presented as student attendance days.
The revised PDF identifies December 17 as an emergency closure and February 13 as the make-up attendance day, while May 22 and the post-year dates remain conditional.
The footer says lunch is served on attendance days except Fair Day and the last day of school.
PSD's bell page confirms the three schedule lengths but lists different actual times by school, so this page does not assign one clock time to every campus.
